properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency (via the elliptic/secp256k1 ECDSA toolchain pulled by the Solana JS stack). hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 in the build image; no direct import or call site found in the application source. Presence is the inventory fact: available in the shipped library, not invoked by this app.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js arrives transitively via merkletreejs@0.2.32 (yarn.lock:3159) in the Metaplex/web3 toolchain. MD5 is collision-broken; it ships in the image, though no direct MD5 call site exists in the application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same crypto-js@3.3.0 transitive package (via merkletreejs). SHA-1 is collision-broken; shipped in the image, no direct call site in app code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive: @noble/curves is pulled by the Solana/Ethereum JS toolchain (@noble/hashes consumers). secp256k1 ECDSA available in the image; no direct import in the application source. Migration is a vendor/protocol concern for Solana-adjacent libraries, not changeable by this app alone.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive: elliptic is required by secp256k1@^4.0.2 (itself transitive) and the jws/jwa chain's ecdsa-sig-formatter. ECDSA (P-256/secp256k1) available in the image; no direct import in the application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive via @noble/curves@1.4.0 in the Solana JS toolchain. P-256 ECDSA available in the image; no direct app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive via elliptic@6.5.5 (secp256k1 chain). ECDH key agreement available in the shipped image; no direct app call site — the app's live key agreement surface is Solana's Ed25519 signing, not ECDH.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is a real runtime dependency of @solana/web3.js (Keypair.fromSecretKey → nacl.sign.keyPair). The app actively uses tweetnacl's Ed25519 signing on every trade; X25519 (scalar mult / DH) is the same library's additional shipped capability with no app call site. Changeable here only by the Solana protocol, which mandates Ed25519 transaction signatures.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive: scrypt-js@3.0.1 pulled by the Metaplex/wallet stack (yarn.lock:220). Password-KDF capability ships in the image; no direct import in the application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive via @noble/hashes@1.4.0 (pulled with @noble/curves by the Solana JS toolchain). SHA-3 available in the image; no direct app call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 is loaded at runtime by @solana/web3.js; its secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption) ships in the image as an available capability. The app's live use of the library is Ed25519 signing; no XSalsa20-Poly1305 call site found in application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jws is the JWS sign/verify engine jsonwebtoken@9 delegates to — it is the live path behind middleware/auth.ts jwt.verify(). JWS is a container format, not a cipher; the underlying algorithms (HMAC-SHA256 by default) are selected at token-verification time. Same package as the LIB-9d851bd4 entry — linked to avoid double-counting one lockfile package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: jwa is the JWA algorithm-dispatch layer under jws (HMAC/ECDSA/RSA signing and verification for JWTs). It is live code behind the app's jwt.verify in middleware/auth.ts and notably pulls in buffer-equal-constant-time — the only constant-time comparison in the dependency tree. JWA is an algorithm registry, not a cipher itself; linked to its package entry.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency: crypto-js@3.3.0 arrives via merkletreejs@0.2.32 (yarn.lock:3159) in the Metaplex/web3 toolchain. It ships MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, AES, DES, PBKDF2, HMAC in the build image. No direct import found in the application source — available in the shipped library, not invoked by this app.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency in the live JWT path: jsonwebtoken@9.0.2 → jws@3.2.2 → jwa@1.4.1. jwa performs the JWT algorithm selection/signing (HMAC-SHA256 with a string secret, as used in middleware/auth.ts) and depends on buffer-equal-constant-time and ecdsa-sig-formatter. Reachable at runtime when authMiddleware is mounted.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Direct dependency declared in package.json:25 ("bcryptjs": "^2.4.3") but never imported anywhere in the application source — a dead dependency. bcrypt (password hashing) still ships in the build image and would be available to any future code. Algorithm-level twin of ALG-2384a3f4 (bcrypt) which is in the other scout's shard.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency in the live JWT path: jsonwebtoken@9.0.2 → jws@3.2.2. jws is the JWS sign/verify implementation that middleware/auth.ts's jwt.verify reaches at runtime. Also the same package described by the JWS algorithm entry (ALG-5bdcede9, linked there).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency: elliptic@6.5.5 (from ^6.5.4) required by secp256k1@^4.0.2 and used via ecdsa-sig-formatter in the jws/jwa JWT chain. Ships ECDSA (P-256/secp256k1) and ECDH in the build image; no direct import in the application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency: pbkdf2@3.1.2 is the browser-polyfill PBKDF2 pulled by the Solana/Metaplex JS stack (yarn.lock:1662, 1671). Password-KDF capability ships in the image; no direct import or PBKDF2 call site found in the application source. Algorithm-level twin of ALG-4de3b020 (PBKDF2) in the other scout's shard.
